blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prevent practices that have an adverse effect on market competition.
Actively promote and sustain fair competition in markets.
Ensure the freedom of trade for all market participants.

blocks.content: • Promote and sustain competition in markets.

items: Exams frequently ask to identify the statutory objectives of the Competition Commission of India (CCI).
Remember that protecting consumer interests and ensuring freedom of trade are explicit legislative mandates of CCI.
